item.title: Managing Users in Active Directory
item.description: Why Learn User Management in Active Directory Managing user accounts is one of the most essential responsibilities of a Windows Server administrator. This guide walks through: Creating a user First-time login on Windows 10 Resetting passwords Disabling and enabling accounts Deleting users and seeing the authentication outcome Each step includes screenshots for clear documentation and learning. Note: This is a detailed post with many screenshots and multiple sections. To navigate quickly, use your browser’s search function (Ctrl + F or Cmd + F) and look for keywords such as create, reset, enable, disable, or delete depending on the task you want to review.
